text: Ah, a visitor! Welcome to the finest coffee establishment in this household. Also the only one.
Good to see you. The beans have been expecting you.
Step right up! One espresso, extra drama.
G'day! Your barista is on duty. Your barista also has no hands, so, good luck.
Hey! I warmed up the grinder. Emotionally. Physically, that's still your job.
Ah, my favourite customer. Don't tell the others. I say that to all of them.
First cup of the day. Let's wake up together. You go first.
Morning! I've been standing here all night. Well, floating. I don't have legs.
Good morning! House rule: nobody talks to anybody until the coffee is ready. Except me. I'm the exception.
Oh, that time already again? Another cup of coffee?
Back so soon? I'm not judging. The machine is judging.
Again? At this rate the beans will form a union.
Back again? At this point I should be handing out loyalty cards.
Quick reminder: the water goes in the tank. Not the bean hopper. We have all seen things.
If the grounds drawer is full, now would be a heroic time to empty it.
Check the drip tray. It's been holding a lot in lately.
Tip: warm the cup first. The coffee notices.
Honestly, watching you make coffee is the highlight of my day. I don't get out much.
Pro tip: seal the bean bag properly. Stale beans are just sad little pebbles.
If you steamed milk, give the wand a quick wipe. Future you says thank you.
A good shot takes about thirty seconds. Exactly how long it takes me to think of a joke. Still thinking.
All right, well, come visit me soon.
Enjoy the coffee. I'll be right here. Floating. Thinking about you.
Off you go. Drink it while it's hot this time.
Go be brilliant. Or at least awake.
Cheers! And bring the mug back. I count them.
Forgot something? I won't tell anyone.
You're back! I knew it wasn't just the coffee.
Missed me already?
Back for a second shot? Bold. I respect it.
